intro: A 2017 Honda CR-V takes different amounts of oil depending on the engine. The 1.5L turbo (L15B) takes 3.7 US qt with a filter change, or 3.4 qt without. The 2.4L (K24W) takes 4.7 US qt with a filter, or 4.4 qt without (owner's manual P/N 31TLA6000, p.637). Both engines specify Genuine Honda Motor Oil 0W-20, or API premium-grade 0W-20 (p.556).
Tire sizes this year are 235/65R17 (32 psi front, 30 psi rear) and 235/60R18 (33 psi front, 30 psi rear), p.637. Cold pressures differ front to rear. The compact spare is a T155/90D17 112M at 60 psi.

NHTSA lists 7 campaigns for the 2017 CR-V (database fetched 2026-11-02). They include an electric power-steering campaign (18V663000), a fuel-hose campaign (17V442000), and a later fuel-pump campaign (23V858000). Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

What changed from 2016: the previous year's page lists only the 2.4L, at 4.6 qt with filter and 4.4 qt without (manual P/N 31T0A6400, p.520). Its tire sizes were 215/70R16, 225/65R17 and P225/60R18, with equal front and rear pressures (32 or 33 psi). The 2016 spare is listed as a T155/90D17 101M at 60 psi, not the 112M spare used on the 2017 page.

manual.note: Honda 2017 CR-V Owner's Manual (PDF, 663 pp; footer 17 CR-V-31TLA6000). Oil and tires p.637, viscosity p.556, towing p.439, TPMS p.503-505. No battery capacity is printed. Printed page = PDF page - 2.

oilCapacity.appliesTo: Two engines were offered: 1.5L turbo on most trims and 2.4L on the LX. 2WD and AWD share the same fill.

oilViscosity.value: Genuine Honda Motor Oil 0W-20 or API Premium-grade 0W-20 detergent oil

batteryGroup.note: this edition prints no battery reserve-capacity or BCI group number

tpmsReset.value: Press and hold the TPMS button until the low tire pressure/TPMS indicator blinks twice; calibration then finishes automatically after about 30 minutes of cumulative driving at 30-65 mph. With the driver information interface or Display Audio, use Vehicle Settings > TPMS Calibration > Calibrate.

tires.note: Compact spare: T155/90D17 112M at 60 psi. Cold pressures differ front/rear.
